tutorial.say: This clue (a smiling face) counts the SURROUNDED bombs in its 3x3 block. A bomb is surrounded when all four cells next to it (up, down, left, right) are bombs too.
Five bombs in this block form a plus, but only the middle one has bombs on all four sides. The other four have free cells beside them. That is why the clue says 1.

The edge of the grid counts as a bomb. In this corner, the bomb has bombs to its right and below it, and the edge on its other two sides: it is surrounded. This clue sees two surrounded bombs - the corner one and the middle of the plus - so it says 2.

tutorial.play: Your turn! The board is cleared again. Find all the bombs.
